p: Sanders remains in the mix to start Sunday; Monken has not ruled him in or out.
A strong first extended showing keeps him in the starting-QB conversation, but the decision is still open, so he is a watch-and-wait add rather than a confirmed starter.
It gives me more and more confidence at what I saw in the fall
Monken wouldn't discuss the quarterback situation or whether Sanders made a case to start, so the QB job is unresolved for now.
Sanders will take first-team reps today and will start Sunday if Watson is not cleared.
He is a live QB streamer or Superflex option if Watson is ruled out, and the team has game-planned for him.
I can't wait. This is so cool.
